create_simulator_reset: create a python module that resets a Habitat Simulator and returns initial observations
build_simulator_step: build a python module that steps a Habitat Simulator with an action and returns observations
test_geodesic_distance: test the Simulator geodesic_distance method to calculate shortest path distance between two points
refactor_action_space_shortest_path: refactor the Simulator action_space_shortest_path method to compute shortest path between source and target agent states
review_sensor_suite_observations: review the SensorSuite get_observations method to collect observations from all sensors in the suite
